_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.160 (The Horde profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: Fearsome alien swarm that overwhelms enemies through sheer numbers. Horde forces merge together and keep fighting even when broken.

traits.name: Fearsome
traits.description: The Horde inflicts Fear (see page 45) except in Synthetic beings.

traits.name: Horde Tactics
traits.description: At the start of a round, any number of Horde squads that are within Coherency distance of each other may be declared to use Horde tactics. They are treated as a single squad going forward and cannot be separated during the battle. Squad special abilities such as recon squads do not apply.

traits.name: Uncaring
traits.description: A Horde squad with two or more figures remaining is not destroyed when failing a Morale test. Instead, remove one figure from the squad.
